title: NWM Campaign Dashboard
description: Per-campaign delivery, revenue, margin and KPI pacing for a NWM campaign, joined SSP<->DSP. Config carries the campaign identity, channels with their KPI targets and thresholds, the deal registry and the revshare map; the data payload carries one row per (deal, day) plus join diagnostics. Ships empty: every section renders its awaiting-first-ingest state until the first update_page_data.
note: Viewable impressions are optional. A DSP export without a viewability column (DV360 Overall without Active View, Amazon) now fits the template: Viewability renders N/A instead of a fabricated 0.0%, and when only some days report it the rate covers just those days' impressions. Rows that carry the field render exactly as before.
